title: Coverage map
description: <port>/state/coverage_map.json: for every module of the original, whether each public name is implemented in Python or in Rust.

format_version.description: Version of this file's format. Readers refuse any value other than 1.

modules.description: One entry per module, keyed by its dotted import name.

status.description: Where the module is in the port. Every module is "python" until module status transitions exist.

coverage_percent.description: Line coverage of the module by the original tests, measured on the original; null until analysis has measured it.

public_names.description: One entry per public name of the module.

public_name.description: Implementation of one public name. A Python name carries a string reason (an empty reason fails the oracle); a Rust name carries null.

oneOf.description: The name still runs the original Python code.

implementation.description: The name is implemented in Python.

reason.description: Why the name is left in Python; empty until someone records one.

oneOf.description: The name is backed by the Rust build.

implementation.description: The name is implemented in Rust.

reason.description: Always null: a swapped name needs no reason.
